proposal.summary: A file upload vulnerability in DWSurvey OSS v3.2.0 and earlier allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and saveFile in action/UploadAction.java.
proposal.cwe_quote: File Upload vulnerability in DWSurvey DWSurvey-OSS v.3.2.0 and before allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and savveFile in the action/UploadAction.java file.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vulnerable source (action/UploadAction.java) and review the saveimage/saveFile implementations to confirm upload validation and execution paths; if confirmed, prepare coordinated disclosure and provide patch removing arbitrary-code execution (validate file type, restrict upload paths, run as unprivileged user).
